identical_duplicate_policy: drop exact repeats in derivative only
primary_rule: (min ligand-to-VHL distance <5 Å) AND (min ligand-to-POI distance <5 Å) at aligned timestamps
contact_scope: Actual stored Other/VHL/Kinase index groups; composition recorded, not silently redefined as heavy atoms
limitations: Reuses stored distances; does not independently recompute periodic distances or prove correct index-to-TPR correspondence.
GRO hydrogen counts use atom names; topology is needed for exact element/mass identity.
Pose-sampled frame occupancy is not equilibrium binding probability, degradation probability or a free energy.
Correlated frames and bridge-selected starting poses preclude treating every frame/pose as an independent biological replicate.
